overview: Gandhi, satyagrahas, Patel, Bose, Ambedkar and post-1947 consolidation and reorganisation of states: 14 official questions (2008-2024), mostly one-liners (11) on years, places, slogans and books. Reorganisation of states (4, all 2008-10) and Bose (3) lead; Patel and Ambedkar's constitutional role are not yet asked.

possibility.evidence: 2 Qs: 2019, 2023 (both on Ruskin's Unto This Last)
possibility.what_they_ask: which book shaped him and what he called his translation (Sarvodaya); natural targets: Hind Swaraj, Tolstoy, Thoreau
year of first satyagraha (South Africa 1906), when he entered national politics, why salt was chosen
natural targets: Kheda 1918, Bardoli 1928 ('Sardar'), Karachi 1931 president, States Department, Operation Polo (Hyderabad, Sept 1948)

possibility.angle: Subhas Chandra Bose and the INA
possibility.what_they_ask: slogans (Dilli Chalo), where INA started (Singapore), who faced the Red Fort trial

possibility.angle: Integration of princely states / Praja Mandals
possibility.what_they_ask: Praja Mandal leader-region pairs; natural targets: Instrument of Accession, Junagadh, Hyderabad, Kashmir
attribution of a quote on caste (Annihilation of Caste)

possibility.angle: Ambedkar and the making of the Constitution
possibility.what_they_ask: natural targets: Drafting Committee chairman (29 Aug 1947), Poona Pact 1932, Art. 32 'heart and soul', his organisations and papers

possibility.angle: Reorganisation of states and Andhra/Telangana politics
possibility.what_they_ask: first linguistic state year; chronology of state creation; Telangana Praja Samithi; cause of 1973 President's Rule in AP

traps.spot: Options 1952, 1953, 1956, 1957 for the first linguistic state
traps.fix: Potti Sriramulu died Dec 1952; Andhra State 1 Oct 1953; States Reorganisation / Andhra Pradesh 1956

traps.trap: Defence counsel slipped among the accused
traps.spot: INA trial list with Bhulabhai Desai
traps.fix: Accused: Sahgal, Dhillon, Shah Nawaz Khan; Desai led the defence

traps.trap: Two movements of the same region swapped by year
traps.spot: 1973 President's Rule in AP with 'Telangana agitation' option
traps.fix: 1969 = Telangana agitation; 1972-73 = Jai Andhra; legal formula is not the cause

traps.trap: Leader placed in the wrong princely region
traps.fix: Balwantrai Mehta = Kathiawar (Gujarat); Pathik = Rajasthan; Thikriwala = Punjab; Sarangadhar Das = Orissa

traps.trap: Influence swapped between Ruskin and Tolstoy
traps.spot: Book options by Ruskin, Tolstoy, Marx, Gorky
traps.fix: Unto This Last (Ruskin) → Sarvodaya; Tolstoy → Tolstoy Farm, Kingdom of God is Within You

traps.trap: Slogan given to the wrong leader
traps.spot: Famous calls with Gandhi, Nehru, Bose, Tilak
traps.fix: Dilli Chalo / Jai Hind = Bose; Do or Die = Gandhi; Swaraj my birthright = Tilak

techniques.name: Statehood date ladder
techniques.how: [Year ladder] Keep 1953 Andhra, 1956 SRA, 1960 Maharashtra/Gujarat, 1963 Nagaland, 1966 Haryana, 1971 HP, 1972 NE trio, 1975 Sikkim, 1987 Mizoram/Arunachal/Goa; order codes by it.
techniques.example: Maharashtra 1960 - Haryana 1966 - HP 1971 - Mizoram 1987 → 'B, D, A, C'; 'B, A, D, C' puts HP before Haryana [group1-prelims-2008#85]

techniques.name: Gandhi life timeline
techniques.how: Fix 1893 South Africa, 1906 first satyagraha, 1915 return, 1917 Champaran, 1919 Rowlatt, 1930 Dandi; locate the stem's event on it.
techniques.example: First satyagraha in South Africa → 1906 (Transvaal registration ordinance); 1915 is his return [group1-prelims-2010#73]

techniques.name: Role separation in trials and movements
techniques.how: For any trial or movement list, sort names into accused / defence / organiser before choosing.
techniques.example: Red Fort trial: three officers accused, Desai defence → drop (d) [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#28]

techniques.name: Place of formation check
techniques.how: Distinguish where a body was formed from where its leader worked earlier.
techniques.example: INA formed and revived at Singapore; Berlin had the Free India Legion [group1-prelims-2010-reexam#99]

techniques.name: Quote-to-thinker by core idea
techniques.how: Match the idea, not the tone: abolishing caste = Ambedkar; reforming untouchability within Hinduism = Gandhi.
techniques.example: 'Nothing can emancipate the outcaste except destruction of caste' → Ambedkar [group1-prelims-2019-paper1#24]

confusions.remember: first linguistic state (Kurnool) vs merger with Telangana under SRA

confusions.b: Kingdom of God is Within You (Tolstoy)

confusions.remember: first in India vs first all-India
Punjab split vs UT to state

anchors: 1906 first satyagraha (Transvaal); 1915 return (9 January); 1917 Champaran; 1919 Rowlatt
Salt: tax plus monopoly; Dandi 12 March - 6 April 1930
Bose: Forward Bloc 1939; Provisional Government 21 Oct 1943, Singapore; 'Dilli Chalo'
Red Fort trial 1945: Sahgal, Dhillon, Shah Nawaz Khan; defence Bhulabhai Desai
Ambedkar: Annihilation of Caste 1936; Drafting Committee chairman 1947
Potti Sriramulu died 15 Dec 1952; Andhra State 1 Oct 1953; SRA 1956
checklist: Year options in a row (1952/53/56)? Name what happened in each before choosing.
Separate accused, defence and organisers in any list of names.
Book or idea questions: tie book to author, then author to Gandhi's translation.
For state creation, run the statehood ladder.
For Andhra/Telangana politics, fix the decade of the movement first.
